{{Quote|Get him!|Commander Appo chasing Zett Jukassa|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
'''Zett Jukassa''' (born '''Warpoc Skamini''')<ref name="Databank" /> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the final days of both institutions. Apprenticed to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mierme Unill]] at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was reassigned to [[Battlemaster/Legends|Temple Battlemaster]] [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] following Unill's death. Jukassa was stationed at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] with Drallig when the ancient edifice was invaded by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] under the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|orders]] of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Fleeing the Temple, Jukassa was shot and killed by Clone Sergeant Fox in front of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]].

==Biography==

===Early life===
[[File:ZettJukassa-SS.png|thumb|left|180px|Padawan Jukassa with his lightsaber.]]
Born to [[Sembric Skamini|Sembric]] and [[Ashielle Skamini]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], the young boy named Warpoc Skamini was identified as a newborn to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and sent by his parents to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Databank" />

While studying at the Temple [[Jedi academy|academy]], a seven year old Jukassa began to receive visions of his parents' brutal murder on his homeworld. Unaware of his heritage per Order policy, Jukassa's plight reached the ears of the Jedi [[Jedi investigator/Legends|investigating]] the murders, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mierme Unill]]. With the permission of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Unill and [[Lore Keeper|Chief Librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] related the facts of the murders to Jukassa in hopes that he could ease the boy's suffering, and discover clues to the murderer's identity. Unill's intuition proved correct in this case, leading him to uncover ties to [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] in his investigation thanks to Jukassa's assistance. Following the arrests, Unill was so impressed with Jukassa's maturity and strength that he selected him to be his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprentice.<ref name="Databank" />

===The Clone Wars===
While Jukassa seemed to show a propensity for the ability known as [[Farsight/Legends|Farsight]], Unill did not have time to expand on this ability as the tensions between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] interrupted regular training within the Order. Called into service within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], Jukassa was given the rank of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] and aided his Master in campaigns outside the Temple walls. While on the battlefield, Unill was slain by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], leaving Jukassa an orphaned Padawan and confined to the Temple on Coruscant. Continuing his studies at the academy, he was temporarily assigned to [[Battlemaster/Legends|Temple Battlemaster]] [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]].<ref name="Databank" />

<div style="float:right"></div>

Following the deaths of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the High Council moved against the Supreme Chancellor who was in fact the elusive [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Still stationed at the Temple, Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] armed him and other Padawan and Knights as the Temple went on high alert. Under the leadership of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the Grand Army that the Jedi had served side-by-side with invaded the Temple, slaying all within.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Death===
[[File:Zett_Jukasa_Order_66.png|thumb|250x250px|Jukassa fights [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during the execution of [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]].]]Fleeing to the upper levels, Jukassa fought his way through one of the [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] and onto the landing platform. Out in the night air, Jukassa raced for the recently landed [[XJ-2 airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] that belonged to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], a long time supporter and friend of the Jedi who had come to investigate the smoke rising from the ancient edifice. On his way to freedom, Jukassa cut through eight troopers wounding the assault's leader, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Appo/Legends|Appo]], in the process. However, before he could make it to the speeder, Jukassa was shot dead by the accurate blaster-handling of Sergeant [[Fox (501st Legion)/Legends|Fox]]. Fleeing the scene after Jukassa's death, Senator Organa departed Coruscant in search of any surviving Jedi.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Legacy===
As official documents were pulled together by the Imperial [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] issued propaganda stating Jukassa was neutralized after he was heard threatening to kill Senator Organa. The true account of his death was presented to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], but was never made public.<ref name="Order 66: Destroy All Jedi">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:ZettJukassa-RotS.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Zett Jukassa]]
Zett Jukassa possessed a strong connection to the Force and was gifted in the rare ability of [[Farsight/Legends|farsight]]. One of the Jedi Temple's most promising students, Jukassa put up a valiant defense during the raid on the Jedi Temple. Impressively the young Padawan almost escaped the Temple, but was finally shot down by Sergeant [[Fox (501st Legion)/Legends|Fox]] before he could reach Bail Organa's speeder.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zett Jukassa was played by [[Jett Lucas]], son of [[George Lucas]]. When naming the character, many possibilities were discussed, including ''Titi Jukassa'', ''Tado Jukassa'', and ''Tado''. Eventually a [[tuckerization]] of the name Lucas was created: ''Jukassa'', and Jett's name was simply modified to ''Zett''.<ref name="Databank" />

Jett Lucas also played the Padawan Warpoc Skamini in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], though after the release of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], the two characters were merged into one with a backstory.<ref name="SWArchive-The Force Runs Strong In This Family: Jett, Amanda & Katie: Cameo Appearances">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/profile/f20051221/index.html|text=The Force Runs Strong In This Family: Jett, Amanda & Katie}}</ref>
